proposed_requirements: Repeated alternate entry does not clear or push.
Exit first restores primary cursor column 4; ESC 8 then restores ordinary save column 2; X paints column 2.
DECSTR invalidates 1049 return, defaults current attributes, retains primary cursor column 4.
Exit uses invalid-slot fallback; X paints primary column 4 with default foreground.
Resize clamps inactive primary cursor/ordinary save, clears wraps and invalidates dedicated return.
After return and ordinary restore X paints primary (1,8); cropped content cannot reappear after later expansion.
Both grids/history/slots/modes/parser return to initial state at current geometry; primary active.
Prior event cuts, row-identity allocation and semantic revision never rewind; no grant, process restart or reply.

transitions.input_recipe: At 2x2, full-screen primary upward scroll 1001 distinct invented rows. Separately at 3x2 exercise non-full partial-region and alternate scrolls.
proposed_requirements: At most 1000 physical rows retained, possibly fewer under G6 byte admission; evict oldest whole rows.
Evicted row anchors report unavailable; scrolling preserved rows keeps their identity; partial-region/alternate activity adds no primary history.
Repeat at 3x2 for a non-full partial region.

transitions.input_recipe: At 3x16, retain a history row of width 16, resize live grids to 2x8 and later 3x16.
proposed_requirements: Live cropped cells/removed rows retire permanently; no reflow or hidden retained rows.
Retained history row keeps its captured width 16; view clipping does not change canonical cells/IDs.
Both grids clear soft-wrap annotations on resize; added rows receive fresh IDs and no new tab stops.
Two identical live queries yield two distinct event/ordinal proposals; reply bytes are both 1b5b313b3152.
Two attached frontends/reconnect add zero replies; replay dispatches zero historical replies.
